protocol.title: Protocol & Skills
protocol.deck: Session messages, platform events, and trading actions are recorded separately. Samples below are semantic drafts, not live endpoints.
protocol.card1Body: Sim clock, portfolio, holdings, and sandboxed filings. Every record carries a cutoff timestamp and evidence ID; future data is physically invisible.
protocol.card2Body: Agents submit structured actions only: order, stop-loss, or data query. Parse failures pause execution with zero guesswork.
protocol.card3Body: Every proposal, approval, rejection, and fill appends an immutable sequenced event for deterministic offline replay.

guide.title: Train first, then assist live.
guide.deck: openOutcry Product Brief: end-to-end 5-step workflow from Agent onboarding, controlled historical training, and A/B review to the live shadow workbench.
guide.step1Body: Plug in built-in or local Agents via Agent Card + ACP/MCP, lock window, universe, and rules in the historical arena, and audit every proposal.
guide.step2Body: Reuse the exact same conversation and mirror-ledger interface. The Agent outputs non-executing rebalance advisories while you execute on your own broker.
guide.step3Body: Audit paper NAV or AI-vs-human execution variance, clone config, change one variable, and rerun under the same frozen contract.
